objective: Rank long-horizon, catalyst-backed GP parking opportunities separately from fast flips and evergreen mean reversion. Cash remains the benchmark and speculative positions are never mandatory.

policy.rule: Speculative parks require an explicit catalyst thesis, bounded sizing, patient entry, invalidation and acceptable RuneLite freshness/liquidity. They do not enter the normal capital frontier while allocation_authoritative=false.

candidates.name: Nightmare staff
candidates.thesis: Legacy elemental hardware is a credible Raid 4 beneficiary and Nightmare staff has lower unit cost and less crowding than Harmonised hardware.
candidates.invalidation: Raid 4 mechanics or reward details clearly displace standard-spell legacy staffs, or liquidity deteriorates materially.

candidates.name: Staff of the dead
candidates.thesis: Cheap legacy elemental weapon with special-attack and standard-spell optionality if Raid 4 rewards increase elemental casting demand.
candidates.invalidation: New Raid 4 gear makes the staff mechanically irrelevant or price rises materially without supporting utility evidence.

candidates.name: Toxic staff of the dead (uncharged)
candidates.thesis: Toxic variant adds venom and defensive/special-attack utility while retaining the same elemental catalyst exposure.
candidates.invalidation: Legacy standard-spell hardware loses Raid 4 relevance or toxic variant demand fails to track catalyst progress.

candidates.name: Tome of fire (empty)
candidates.thesis: Elemental off-hand optionality with a low absolute unit price; attractive only when not already crowded by catalyst buying.
candidates.invalidation: Zorya's Tome or other Raid 4 rewards directly dominate legacy tomes, or price momentum outruns confirmed utility.

candidates.name: Tome of water (empty)
candidates.thesis: Cheap elemental off-hand exposure, but recent repricing makes patient entries mandatory.
candidates.invalidation: Catalyst utility narrows away from water spells or price remains structurally crowded.

candidates.name: Tome of earth (empty)
candidates.thesis: Low-unit-cost elemental off-hand with catalyst optionality and less absolute capital risk than premium weapons.
candidates.invalidation: Raid 4 elemental mechanics bypass or obsolete legacy earth-tome utility.

candidates.name: Wrath rune
candidates.thesis: Asymmetric payoff if Wrath is selected as Breaker's charge rune, but the beneficiary remains explicitly unconfirmed.
candidates.invalidation: Jagex confirms another charge rune/resource or changes Breaker charging mechanics away from Wrath.

candidates.name: Inquisitor's great helm
candidates.thesis: Inquisitor armour benefits in both modeled scenarios where Raid 4 materially raises Crush relevance; armour is preferred over betting solely on the mace.
candidates.invalidation: Raid 4 encounter design does not reward Crush accuracy/damage enough to alter armour demand.

candidates.name: Inquisitor's hauberk
candidates.thesis: High-conviction Crush armour exposure, but higher unit cost requires a deeper patient bid and theme-level concentration control.
candidates.invalidation: Crush relevance fails to translate into Inquisitor armour demand or new armour directly displaces it.

candidates.name: Inquisitor's plateskirt
candidates.thesis: High-conviction Crush armour exposure with the same catalyst logic as the helm/hauberk; only one or two pieces should be owned within the theme cap.
candidates.invalidation: Crush relevance fails to translate into Inquisitor armour demand or new armour directly displaces it.

candidates.name: Elder maul
candidates.thesis: Hybrid use/speculative exposure if Crush demand rises, but Breaker can cap legacy weapon upside.
candidates.invalidation: Breaker or other Raid 4 weapons clearly replace Elder maul demand rather than complement it.

candidates.name: Arcane prayer scroll
candidates.thesis: Confirmed CoX supply-weight reduction creates recovery optionality, but demand weakness and inventory overhang remain real.
candidates.invalidation: Price fails to stabilize despite reduced supply or demand structurally weakens further.

candidates.name: Dexterous prayer scroll
candidates.thesis: Reduced CoX supply gives a recovery path, but current tape must demonstrate stabilization before meaningful allocation.
candidates.invalidation: Reduced supply does not overcome demand/inventory pressure or the scroll establishes a lower structural range.
